run_f_gold: run f_gold to count natural numbers whose permutation is greater than a given number n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input parameters and compare results with a filled implementation
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses a stack-based approach to enumerate valid numbers up to n
review_f_gold: review the f_gold algorithm that iterates digits 1-9 and builds numbers using a stack
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the stack-based enumeration with a more efficient digit-counting approach
